Jitna hum unn cheezon ko value karte hain jo hum bol nahi sakte, utna hum zyada silent ho jaate hain.
Zarurat ho to bolo.
Jitni sakht jung, utni meethi jeet.
Main fail nahi hua. Main ne ten thousand ways dhoondhe jo work nahi karte.
Aantarik shaanti se badi koi taakat nahi hoti.
Grit milti nahi, build hoti hai.
Sabr aur himmat hi asli taj hai.
Shaant mann sab saaf dekhta hai.
Lagataar koshish hi taqat hai.
Chuppi ek shaktishali samvad hai.
Grit wo chup chup ki lagan hai jo shak ki garaj se bhi zyada tikti hai.
Khamoshi ultimate weapon hai.
Grit andar se khojne ka naam hai.
Courage tab shuru hota hai jab hum aate hain aur apne aap ko dikhate hain.
Jo parinaam se darta hai woh apne saahas ko seemit karta hai.
Sabr aqal ka sathi hai.
Himmat phir se khade hona hai.
Himmat change ki backbone hai.
